name: Malaysia: SWCorp separation at source (Act 672 states)
scope: Households in the 7 states that adopted Act 672: Johor, Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perlis, Kedah and the Federal Territories (Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya). Enforced for landed homes since 1 June 2016 and for strata homes since 1 May 2021.
notCovered: Selangor, Penang, Perak, Kelantan, Terengganu, Sabah and Sarawak run their own schemes, which this pack does not cover.

bins.name: Papers
bins.description: Recyclable waste, paper type. Bagged or tied, placed beside the rubbish bin on recyclable collection day (landed homes) or in the recycling cage (strata homes).

bins.name: Plastics
bins.description: Recyclable waste, plastic type. Bagged or tied, placed beside the rubbish bin on recyclable collection day (landed homes) or in the recycling cage (strata homes).

bins.name: Others
bins.description: Recyclable waste, other types: glass, cans, aluminium containers and more. Bagged or tied, placed beside the rubbish bin on recyclable collection day.

bins.name: Residual waste
bins.description: Goes into the rubbish bin. Kitchen waste, food waste, dirty items and disposable nappies. Collected 2x a week.
